notes.title: CNC Milling Machine Bug Fix Update – Edge Finder Issue Resolved
notes.content:
Hey machinists 👋

We owe you an apology on this one — there was a frustrating bug in the CNC Milling Machine DLC where the tool simply wouldn’t cut if the Edge Finder was active. We know how important precision is in machining, and this definitely wasn’t the experience we wanted you to have.

✅ The good news: this issue is now fixed! Your tools will cut properly even with the Edge Finder turned on.

Thank you all for spotting this and letting us know so quickly. Your feedback helps us keep making the simulator sharper, smoother, and closer to the real workshop.

Keep sending us your reports and suggestions — we’re listening! 🙌

notes.title: 🛠️ Update: Workpiece Scaling Fix + General Improvements
notes.content:
📏 Improved Unit Handling for Workpiece Previews

We’ve fixed a major issue where selecting Show Model on the Select Workpiece scene would incorrectly scale the preview model — especially when units were set to INCH. In some cases, the workpiece appeared up to 24 times larger than intended. This is now resolved, and models display accurately based on the selected unit system.



✅ Additional Fixes:

General bug fixes and stability improvements across multiple scenes.

Improved reliability when switching between unit modes.

Minor UI polish and optimization.

Thanks for your feedback and support — keep machining, and happy simulating!



🔧 We're also hard at work on our upcoming CNC Milling Machine DLC — stay tuned for more details soon!

notes.title: 🛠️ Precision Update: Milling Machine Simulator & Lathe Machine DLC 🛠️
notes.content:
Release Notes 🛠️ Milling Machine Simulator & Lathe Machine DLC 🛠️

What's New? 🚀
OBJ File Import: You asked, we delivered! Both the Milling Machine Simulator and Lathe Machine DLC now support importing OBJ files into Free Milling and Turning modes. Get creative with your designs like never before! 🎨✨

Fixes & Improvements 🩹

Lathe Machine Fixes:

 Resolved an issue where max rotations displayed inconsistently in the toolcard depending on how the workpiece was rotated. Your precision matters, and now it's spot on! 🌀✅

Enjoy smoother machining and expanded possibilities in your creations! As always, keep the feedback coming—your input drives us forward. 💡🚀

notes.title: Release 1.32
notes.content:
We're thrilled to bring you the latest update for Milling Machine Simulator and the Lathe Machine DLC, packed with exciting new features and essential fixes to enhance your experience!

What's New?

Milling Machine Simulator:
New Drawing Tools: Now you can sketch your designs directly on your projects with pencil, marker, and eraser tools! Fine-tune your concepts before you cut.
New Tool - High Precision Helical End Mill (Long Reach): Tackle intricate, hard-to-reach areas with this powerful, high-precision cutting tool, perfect for your more complex operations.
Improved Collision Detection: Experience smoother machining and more accurate tool interactions for an even better simulation.

Lathe Machine DLC:
Drawing Tools: The new pencil, marker, and eraser are also available for your lathe projects, offering you more design flexibility.
Fixes & Improvements: We've ironed out issues with collision detection and resolved problems with tool breakage, so your tools behave as they should. Plus, tool names and descriptions are now clearer and more accurate.

This update is all about giving you more control, precision, and a seamless experience. We can't wait for you to explore the new features—jump in and see what’s new!

Happy machining!

notes.title: Release 1.31
notes.content:
Update Notes:
We are excited to bring you a new update with several improvements, fixes, and new features for both Milling Machine Simulator and the Lathe DLC. Thank you for your continued support and feedback!

Added:
Hotkey Functionality: The F key is now a dedicated hotkey for turning the machine on and off.
Calculator Update: Numpad keys are now fully supported in the calculator for easier input.

Changed:
Clamps Adjustment: In all clamps (Vise, Dividing head, Chuck, Drill Chuck), you no longer need to fully open the clamps to adjust the workpiece or tool inside them, allowing for a smoother workflow.

Fixed:
STL and OBJ Export: We resolved issues with exporting the workpiece to STL and OBJ formats.
Calculator Focus Issue: Fixed a bug where numbers were still being typed into the calculator even when the focus was on another input field.
Undo Feature: Addressed an issue where the Undo function wasn't working properly.

We hope these changes improve your experience with the game. As always, keep the feedback coming and enjoy the new update!

notes.title: Release 1.30
notes.content:
📢 Milling Machine Simulator DLC Update Announcement! 🛠️

Hello Machinists,

We’re back from our well-deserved vacation and are supercharged to bring you some exciting new updates for the Lathe Machine DLC in Milling Machine Simulator! We’ve been hard at work to enhance your experience, and we’re thrilled to share what’s new:

🆕 New Tools
Knurling Tool: Add precise textures and grip to your workpieces with the new Knurling Tool. Perfect for giving your projects that professional touch with non-slip surfaces.

Boring Bar Tool: Achieve flawless internal machining with the Boring Bar Tool. Whether you’re working on fine-tuning internal diameters or creating smooth bores, this tool will get the job done with precision.

Tool Movement Issue: We’ve fixed the issue where tool movement was blocked when the live center was closed. Now you can enjoy seamless operation every time you work on your projects.

We’re recharged and ready to keep improving your machining experience. We value your feedback and suggestions—feel free to reach out to us at iigor.frank@gmail.com. Your input is essential in helping us shape the future of Milling Machine Simulator.

Thank you for your continued support, and happy machining! 🛠️

— The Milling Machine Simulator Team

notes.title: Release 1.29
notes.content:
Dear Machinists,

We are thrilled to announce a brand-new update for Milling Machine Simulator on Steam! This update brings several exciting features and crucial fixes to enhance your simulation experience.

What's New?
Milling Machine Simulator


 Enhanced Control Panel: We’ve added a vise, dividing head, and tool holder controller to the top of the window, just like in Lathe Machine. This will give you even more control and precision in your machining projects.
 Improved T-slot Tool: We’ve fixed an issue where the height was not being cut correctly and the stem diameter was not set properly. Your T-slot tool will now perform with the accuracy you expect.
 Tool Holder Dynamics: Tools can now fall off the tool holder, adding an extra layer of realism. Be sure to keep an eye on your tools!


Milling Machine and Lathe Machine DLC


 Coolant Visibility Fix: We’ve addressed an issue where the coolant was not visible in some cases. Your machine’s coolant will now display correctly, ensuring optimal performance.
 Custom Camera Positions: We now support manually setting camera positions for the F1, F2, and F3 buttons. Personalize your workspace and get the perfect view for your machining tasks.
 We hope these updates bring more realism and enjoyment to your simulation experience. Your feedback has been invaluable in making these improvements, and we look forward to hearing your thoughts on these new features.


Thank you for your continued support and happy machining!

Stay tuned for more updates, and keep those chips flying!

Best regards,

The Milling Machine Simulator Team

notes.title: Release 1.28
notes.content:
Milling Machine Simulator:


 Fixed: Resolved an issue where YouTube tutorial videos were not displaying, resulting in a black screen.
 Fixed: Addressed a significant issue where the tool erroneously detected collisions with the workpiece, even when no material was present.


Lathe Machine DLC:


 Added: Introduced a tooltip notification system for scenarios where the lathe is configured for threads, the machine is turned off, and auto movement is active. In such cases, the machine cannot be manually moved until either auto movement or threads are disabled.
 Fixed: Corrected a bug where repeatedly clicking to change the tool would cause the tool to become hidden, rendering it inaccessible.
 Fixed: Rectified an issue where YouTube tutorial videos failed to display, resulting in a black screen.
 Fixed: Addressed a major issue where the tool incorrectly detected collisions with the workpiece, even in the absence of material.


These updates aim to enhance the overall user experience and ensure smoother gameplay mechanics. We appreciate your continued support and feedback as we strive to improve the Milling Machine Simulator and Lathe Machine DLC. Happy machining!

notes.title: Release 1.27
notes.content:
🎮 Update for Milling Machine Simulator and Lathe Machine DLC

Greetings, Machinists!

We're thrilled to announce the latest update for Milling Machine Simulator and the Lathe Machine DLC, packed with exciting improvements and new features to enhance your machining experience.

Milling Machine Simulator Updates:


 Fixed a critical issue where cutting ceased to function when transitioning from the vise to the dividing head.
 Experience improved lighting in the machine scene.
 Addressed a bug with the dividing head, ensuring that yaws are now opened to the same length when the workpiece is not symmetrical.


Lathe Machine DLC Enhancements:


 Introducing Career Mode! Immerse yourself in a journey of mastery with our new career mode, offering a curated selection of projects to tackle. (Note: Currently featuring 7 projects, with more to come in future updates!)
 Get hands-on control with added support for moving and/or rotating tool on the tool post, allowing for greater precision and customization.
 Experience improved lighting in the machine scene.
 Fixed issues with the opening and closing of the tailstock for smoother operation.
 Addressed a bug with the chuck mechanism, ensuring that yaws are now opened to the same length, even with asymmetrical workpieces.


We're committed to providing you with the best machining simulation experience possible, and that's why we'll be continuously adding new projects to the career mode, expanding your horizons and challenging your skills. Stay tuned for future updates packed with even more exciting features and improvements!

Keep those chips flying and those spindles turning!

notes.title: Release 1.26
notes.content:
🚀 Exciting Update Available for Milling Machine Simulator and Lathe Machine DLC!

We're thrilled to announce a major update for both the Milling Machine Simulator and Lathe Machine DLC, packed with new features and enhancements to elevate your machining experience. Here's what's new:

Milling Machine Simulator:


 Improved Cutting Algorithm: Experience smoother and more precise workpiece cutting with our enhanced algorithm, designed to deliver exceptional results.
 New Coolant System: Stay cool under pressure with our brand-new coolant system, ensuring optimal performance and efficiency during machining operations.
 Coolant Collision: Witness realism in action as coolant now collides with the workpiece, adding a new layer of authenticity to your machining simulations.
 Instantaneous Workpiece Manipulation: Say goodbye to waiting times! Moving or rotating the workpiece on the vise, chuck, or dividing head now happens instantly, without the need for progress bars.
 Unit Correction for Threading: No more unit confusion! We've fixed an issue where threading with incorrect units caused problems, ensuring seamless operation every time.
 Tool Movement Fixes: Enjoy smoother tool movement with fixes addressing instances where tools got stuck inside the workpiece.


Lathe Machine DLC:


 Improved Cutting Algorithm: Experience enhanced cutting performance with our upgraded algorithm, delivering superior results for all your turning projects.
 Support for Eccentric Turning: Unlock new possibilities with support for eccentric turning, allowing you to create unique and complex shapes with precision.
 New Coolant System: Keep your lathe running smoothly with our latest coolant system, providing optimal lubrication and cooling for your turning operations.
 Coolant Collision: Witness realism in action as coolant now interacts with the workpiece, adding an extra layer of authenticity to your machining simulations.
 Instantaneous Workpiece Manipulation: Enjoy instant manipulation of the workpiece on the vise, chuck, or dividing head, eliminating unnecessary delays and streamlining your workflow.
 Tailstock Tool Collider Fixes: We've resolved issues with tailstock tool colliders, ensuring smooth and accurate operation in all situations.


Coming Soon: Career Mode for Lathe Machine DLC!
Exciting news awaits! We're hard at work on a Career Mode for the Lathe Machine DLC, set to be released soon. Stay tuned for an immersive new experience that will challenge and inspire your machining skills.

Update now to access these fantastic features and take your machining simulations to new heights! As always, we appreciate your support and feedback as we continue to improve and expand our machining simulator offerings.

Happy Machining!

UI-Games

notes.title: Release 1.21
notes.content:
🚀 New Update Alert for Milling Machine Simulator! 🚀

Hello to our dedicated machinists and alpha testers,

We're constantly working to elevate your experience. Our latest update zooms in on enhancing the lathe DLC, but we've also patched up a nifty bug in the milling machine department.

🛠️ Enhancements & Additions:

Lathe-centric Features:

Introducing lathe machine hotkeys for efficient operations.
Better shavings visualization: inching closer to a more realistic representation.
The lathe now supports reverse rotation. Take it for a spin!
More control in your hands: adjust the workpiece's position in the chuck, moving it in or out at will.
Added challenge: be mindful, or your tools might break!
Milling Machine Updates:

Fixed a bug where the machine's feed unit retained its previous value on the initial change.
🔍 What's Next for Milling Machine: We've got a slew of exciting features in the pipeline. Stay tuned!

🔧 Fixes and Improvements:

Optimized the Z-axis movement on the lathe.
Refined the lathe machine axis naming for clarity.
Pop-ups won't interfere with lathe hotkeys anymore. No unexpected surprises while you're reading prompts!
Your feedback keeps our gears turning. Jump back in, feel the upgrades, and share your invaluable insights!

Happy Machining,
The UI-Games Team

We're committed to making Milling Machine Simulator the best experience for all of you. Thanks for your continued support and feedback. Happy gaming!
